messages:
natalie: Heads-up: customer pilot wants an on-prem bundle with strict isolation. Main asks: egress locked down to a proxy, customer-managed HSM behind private gateway, and auditable RBAC with quick emergency ops. Can we sketch the minimal config + runbook?

omar: +1. Start with a deny-all outbound posture and only allow the egress-proxy SA to reach the HSM gateway. Use workload identity so pods don't hold cloud creds.

tia: For RBAC, avoid cluster-admin. Create these roles: operator-controller (CRD manage), node-maintainer (patch nodes in a label-scoped pool), and emergency-rotator (short TTL patch on targeted nodes). Wire the rotator to an approval service.

ben: HSM notes: use envelope-encryption on instance with a local cache of wrapped DEKs (TTL 5m). If gateway latency spikes, the cache serves decrypts. But require attestation on startup and log attestation results to the audit stream.

security-bot: [alert] vuln-scan: kms-conn-lib v3.0.1 -> CVE-2025-9999. Severity: high. Recommend upgrade to v3.0.3 or apply backport.

natalie: Can we upgrade with zero downtime?

omar: Plan: rolling update of the connector daemonset behind the proxy. Add a preStop hook to finish inflight decrypts and a readiness probe that verifies a successful HSM handshake. Typical flow: cordon -> drain -> patch DS -> wait readiness -> uncordon.

tia: Also, preserve previous wrapped keys for 48h post-rotation so transient decrypts don't fail. Document this in runbook.

ben: Example NetworkPolicy to allow only proxy egress to HSM gateway (drop everything else):
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-egress-to-hsm-proxy
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: egress-proxy
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.10.0.0/24
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8443
```
Apply a cluster-wide default deny for pods with an explicit allow list for control-plane agents.

ops-oncall: IR quick steps for suspected key compromise: 1) Apply immediate netpol deny to affected pods 2) Revoke short-lived workload certs 3) Rotate CMK/HSM keys and rewrap DEKs 4) Force consumers to re-fetch rewrapped keys 5) Start forensic capture and escalate to SOC/legal if exfil risk > medium.

natalie: Who actually runs the rotation in the pilot? Ops or customer?

omar: Default: operator-run with an authorization token that requires customer-stamp (signed request). Alternative: customer-triggered via a signed API call; both supported. Document both flows.

tia: For audit retention, customer wants 1 year for KMS events, 90 days for control-plane. Sizing note: assume 60 events/s peak, ~1.2KB/event compressed -> ~6.2GB/day for KMS-heavy cluster -> ~2.3TB/year plus metadata. Recommend remote archive to cold storage and daily signed digests for tamper evidence.

security-bot: [info] audit-check: cluster 'pilot-green' has auditPolicy maxLevel: Metadata. Recommend: enable Request/RequestResponse for KMS namespace.

ben: Ops instrumentation: expose /health/kms-attest returning {last_attest_ts, last_ok}. Alert if last_ok older than 60s or attest fails 5x in 10m. Add logs to immutable stream with HMAC-signed batches every 24h.

natalie: Good. Can someone drop minimal rolebinding + emergency-rotator YAML and a netpol template in the infra repo? I want a short bullet list of isolation guarantees for sales.

omar: I'll add the RBAC snippets and approval workflow automation (TTL via our auth-proxy).

tia: I'll author the netpol templates and the preserve-wrapped-keys doc.

ben: I'll wire the KMS health endpoint and the attestation log shipping.

ops-oncall: If any security-bot high alerts appear during the rollout, ping #release-war-room and I'll join the call.

natalie: Draft of minimal isolation guarantees for customer sheet: 
- Network: deny-all by default; only explicit egress to proxy/HSM gateway allowed.
- Keys: customer-managed CMKs in HSM with attestation, envelope-wrapping, and 48h rewrap grace.
- Operations: least-privilege RBAC, label-scoped emergency-rotator with TTL + approval.
- Audit: signed immutable audit export, KMS events retained 1y, control-plane 90d.
- Recovery: documented rewrap and rollback playbook, on-call contact + escalation path.

security-bot: [closed] ticket created: SEC-2025-9999 for connector upgrade tracking.
